stanza: You laugh at every joke

That's how you fight it

Groping blindly, hungry for anything;
Picking through your pocket linings —
Well, what is this?
Scrap of sassafras, eh Sisyphus?

The soil falling over my head
You see, the sea wants to take me, the knife wants to slit me
Do you think you can help me?
Sad-veiled bride, please be happy
Handsome groom, give her room
Loud, loutish lover, treat her kindly
Though she needs you more than she loves you

kindly.lineNext: So this is how I hide the hurt
stanza: I wish that he was here tonight
It's so hard to obey
His sad request of me
To kindly stay away
So this is how I hide the hurt
As the road leads cursed and charmed

But I try to keep it civilized, like Menelik
And other African czars, observing stars with war scars
Get yours in this capitalistic system
So many caught or got bought you can't list them

kindly.linePrev: For somethin' wet and cold as that old cell
kindly.line: That kindly jailer grinned at me
stanza: That kindly jailer grinned at me
All eaten up with sympathy
Then poured himself another beer
And came and whispered in my ear
'If booze was just a dime a bottle
Boy, you couldn't even buy the smell'

kindly.songTitle: Last Words of a Shooting Star
